title: 81-year-old man dies after falling on beach rocks in Romblon

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — An 81-year-old man died after reportedly slipping on rocks and hitting his head at Alcantara town in Romblon, early Wednesday. The victim was found lying face down along the shoreline in Sitio Nipa, Barangay Tugdan, at around 5:15 a.m., according to the Philippine Information Agency in Romblon.
